shock_response.half_life_note: Same reason: the fit needs a declared baseline band to define a deviation to halve.
shock_response.recovery_time_note: NOT COMPUTED HERE BY DESIGN. Recovery time is the first return into a baseline band of +/- epsilon, and epsilon is a threshold. Thresholds and acceptance bands are Week 3 preregistration material; putting one here would preregister it by accident.

ask_size.uncertainty: sd is the sample SD with ddof = 1; standard_error is sd / sqrt(n)

bid_size.uncertainty: sd is the sample SD with ddof = 1; standard_error is sd / sqrt(n)

spread.uncertainty: sd is the sample SD with ddof = 1; standard_error is sd / sqrt(n)

depth.definition: mean over the window of (bid_size + ask_size) / 2 at Level-I

interval.note: an interval is a fixed number of consecutive events; 'fixed_step_count' is the other permitted kind and means a fixed number of engine steps

sampling.note: sampling is event-driven, not clock-driven; a clock-driven rule would need an interpolation rule that this contract does not define

window.note: a window is a fixed number of consecutive intervals; one OLS fit is produced per window
